\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{কৃতী} (kritī)}{কৃতী (kritī)}]{\bn{কৃতী} (kritī) — accomplished; high-achieving}

\label{lesson:BN-C543-kriti}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to come loose, then the Bengali for a muddle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{কৃতী}}
\textbf{\bn{কৃতী}} — \emph{kritī} — \textquotedblleft{}accomplished; high-achieving\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমাদের} \bn{গ্রামের} \bn{এক} \bn{কৃতী} \bn{ছাত্রী} \bn{বৃত্তি} \bn{পেল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmāder grāmer ek kritī chhātrī britti pelô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
An accomplished student from our village won a scholarship.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{কৃতী}} (\emph{kritī}) is Sanskrit \emph{kṛtin}, \textquotedblleft{}one who acts\textquotedblright{}, and so \textquotedblleft{}skilful, successful\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kritī}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kritī}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmāder grāmer ek kritī chhātrī britti pelô.} — An accomplished student from our village won a scholarship.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to come loose, then the Bengali for a muddle, then say \emph{kritī} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{কৃতী} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Accomplished; high-achieving\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সিদ্ধি} (siddhi)}{সিদ্ধি (siddhi)}]{\bn{সিদ্ধি} (siddhi) — success; attainment}

\label{lesson:BN-C543-siddhi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a muddle, then the Bengali for accomplished.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সিদ্ধি}}
\textbf{\bn{সিদ্ধি}} — \emph{siddhi} — \textquotedblleft{}success; attainment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{অনেক} \bn{বছরের} \bn{চেষ্টার} \bn{পরে} \bn{বিজ্ঞানী} \bn{সিদ্ধি} \bn{পেলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ônek bôchhôrer cheshṭār pôre bigyānī siddhi pelen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
After many years of effort the scientist met with success.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সিদ্ধি}} (\emph{siddhi}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{siddhi}, \textquotedblleft{}accomplishment, success\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{siddhi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{siddhi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ônek bôchhôrer cheshṭār pôre bigyānī siddhi pelen.} — After many years of effort the scientist met with success.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a muddle, then the Bengali for accomplished, then say \emph{siddhi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{নিখুঁত} (nikhũt)}{নিখুঁত (nikhũt)}]{\bn{নিখুঁত} (nikhũt) — flawless; perfect}

\label{lesson:BN-C543-nikhut}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for accomplished, then the Bengali for attainment.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{নিখুঁত}}
\textbf{\bn{নিখুঁত}} — \emph{nikhũt} — \textquotedblleft{}flawless; perfect\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{দর্জি} \bn{একটা} \bn{নিখুঁত} \bn{জামা} \bn{বানাল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Dôrji ekṭā nikhũt jāmā bānālô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The tailor made a perfect shirt.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{নিখুঁত}} (\emph{nikhũt}) joins the prefix \bn{নি}-, \textquotedblleft{}without\textquotedblright{}, to \bn{খুঁত}, \textquotedblleft{}a flaw\textquotedblright{}; where \bn{খুঁত} comes from is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nikhũt}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Dôrji ekṭā nikhũt jāmā bānālô.} — The tailor made a perfect shirt.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for accomplished, then the Bengali for attainment, then say \emph{nikhũt} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{হাসিল} \bn{করা} (hāsil kôrā)}{হাসিল করা (hāsil kôrā)}]{\bn{হাসিল} \bn{করা} (hāsil kôrā) — to achieve; to secure}

\label{lesson:BN-C543-hasil-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for attainment, then the Bengali for flawless.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{হাসিল} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{হাসিল} \bn{করা}} — \emph{hāsil kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to achieve; to secure\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{চেষ্টা} \bn{করলে} \bn{আমাদের} \bn{দল} \bn{প্রথম} \bn{পুরস্কার} \bn{হাসিল} \bn{করবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Cheshṭā kôrle āmāder dôl prothom purôskār hāsil kôrbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If our team makes the effort, it will secure first prize.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{পুরস্কারটা} \bn{হাসিল} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini purôskārṭā hāsil kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{হাসিল} \bn{করা}} (\emph{hāsil kôrā}) joins \bn{হাসিল}, \textquotedblleft{}gained, obtained\textquotedblright{}, usually traced to Arabic \emph{ḥāṣil}, \textquotedblleft{}resulting, gained\textquotedblright{}, to \bn{করা}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāsil kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāsil kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Cheshṭā kôrle āmāder dôl prothom purôskār hāsil kôrbe.} — If our team makes the effort, it will secure first prize.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for attainment, then the Bengali for flawless, then say \emph{hāsil kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অভীষ্ট} (ôbhīshṭô)}{অভীষ্ট (ôbhīshṭô)}]{\bn{অভীষ্ট} (ôbhīshṭô) — a desired goal; what one wished for}

\label{lesson:BN-C543-obhishto}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for flawless, then the Bengali for to secure.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অভীষ্ট}}
\textbf{\bn{অভীষ্ট}} — \emph{ôbhīshṭô} — \textquotedblleft{}a desired goal; what one wished for\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{দলটা} \bn{শেষে} \bn{তার} \bn{অভীষ্ট} \bn{পুরস্কার} \bn{পেল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Dôlṭā sheshe tār ôbhīshṭô purôskār pelô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
In the end the team won the prize it had wished for.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অভীষ্ট}} (\emph{ôbhīshṭô}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{abhīṣṭa}, \textquotedblleft{}wished for, dear\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbhīshṭô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbhīshṭô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Dôlṭā sheshe tār ôbhīshṭô purôskār pelô.} — In the end the team won the prize it had wished for.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for flawless, then the Bengali for to secure, then say \emph{ôbhīshṭô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
